final_candidates.decision_summary: Position 521 in the sequence is verified as lysine within the C-terminal stalk-adjacent segment. Alanine here may modulate the G-F interaction surface without disrupting the globular head; purely structure-guided, moderate confidence.

stop_reason.detail: All non-verified-residue candidates were rejected after sequence re-check, and no external evidence is available to justify further rounds.

history.rationale: Lys521 near the TM/cytoplasmic interface can constrain the post-fusion conformation; alanine substitution is expected to modestly increase F-triggering efficiency.
Retention near the C-terminal heptad/stalk-adjacent region could modulate F-interaction; no new evidence to change its standing. Keep pending better-supported candidates.
